title: Sonny and the Misty Creek | Bedtime Story
description: Sonny the Quokka walks through the soft evening mist rising over the creek and discovers how magical the world looks wrapped in silver fog. A dreamy bedtime story for toddlers from Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales.
narration:
Something was different about the creek tonight.

As Sonny the quokka padded along the bank, she noticed it first as a feeling — a cool, soft touch against her fur. Then she saw it.

Mist.

It was rising off the water in thin, pale ribbons, drifting upward into the dark air. The whole creek was wrapped in it. The rocks, the reeds, the low-hanging branches — all of it softened into shapes, like a painting done in whispers.

Sunny walked into the mist.

It was cool and gentle on her nose. It made the world look farther away than it was, and closer at the same time. Every tree became a soft shadow. Every sound seemed muffled and near.

Her paws were damp in the grass. The creek murmured somewhere beside her, invisible now behind its silver veil.

She stopped in the middle of the mist and looked up.

The moon was up there — she could see its glow even through the mist. A soft, blurred circle of light, like a lamp seen through a window.

Sunny breathed in. The misty air tasted clean and green and quiet.

She breathed out.

The mist curled around her paws like something kind. Like a warm blanket, but made of air.

She sat down right there in the middle of the mist and the moonlight and the soft creek murmur.

And she was asleep before she even realised it.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, misty creek. Goodnight, little one.
